decision_2026_07_16.reopening_wording_control: provisional dismissal could lead to reopening with contributions of other indicia
decision_2026_07_16.civil_criminal_boundary: Criminal route must identify alleged autonomous criminal conduct and not operate as generic review of the civil enforcement.

reopening_control.post_finality_rule_boundary: Use new or distinct relevant indicia; do not describe mere re-evaluation of the identical evidential set as a reopening trigger.

publication_boundary.allegation_rule: Attribute allegations and do not convert evidential context into findings of crime, knowledge or intent.

relationship_rule: Cambiario 1048/2019 and ETJ 163/2020 form a civil procedural lineage. DP 748/2026 is legally distinct but factually and evidentially interconnected where primary sources establish a bridge. Separate proceeding does not mean unrelated; same hotel or context does not mean same legal owner, estate or jurisdiction.
liability_boundary: Interlinking establishes navigation and source-controlled factual, evidential or procedural relationships only. It does not establish criminal intent, wrongdoing, liability, agreement, knowledge beyond the exact source, completed assignment, assignee identity or merits attribution.

professional_recovery_communications.title: Cuatrecasas recovery communication identifying RAUDA-addressed collection colleagues
proves: A recovery role was identified and disclosed in the correspondence.
Two claims were asserted; no consolidated liability of all named companies is established by the email.
does_not_prove: A RAUDA advisory mandate, debt acquisition, intended property purchase or unlawful common plan.

professional_recovery_communications.title: Referral of request for itemized claim information to the collection professionals
proves: The request was referred to the identified professionals because of their involvement in proceedings.
does_not_prove: That the information was subsequently supplied or withheld.
Misuse of confidential information, a remate assignment or criminality.

professional_recovery_review.canonical_boundary: Private-professional source controls are kept here; they are not relabelled as public-authority communications. Existing court acts are referenced rather than created again. Email wrappers and internal strategy are not new judicial acts.

open_evidence.custodian_en: Court/LAJ records; each party’s valid service record; instructed counsel
open_evidence.custodian_es: Expediente judicial/LAJ; notificación válida de cada parte; letrado encargado
open_evidence.closure_en: Certified current DP/ETJ docket; exact act and receipt; service to each party; appeal processing; actual adjudication/cession if any. Separate dispatch, receipt, notice, examination and decision.
open_evidence.closure_es: Expediente DP/ETJ certificado y actual; acto y justificante; notificación a cada parte; tramitación del recurso; adjudicación/cesión efectiva, si existe. Separar envío, recepción, notificación, examen y decisión.

open_evidence.title_es: Mandatos, traspaso al recobro e información
open_evidence.custodian_en: Engagement parties; professional firm; recovery entity; lawful file custodians
open_evidence.custodian_es: Partes del encargo; despacho; entidad de recobro; custodios legítimos
open_evidence.closure_en: Accepted engagement, legal client, task, dated instructions, handover, file access and remuneration/conflict controls. Corporate identity does not establish the case mandate.
open_evidence.closure_es: Encargo aceptado, cliente jurídico, tarea, instrucciones fechadas, traspaso, acceso y controles de remuneración/conflicto. La identidad societaria no acredita el mandato del asunto.

open_evidence.custodian_en: Each creditor/obligor; accounts custodian; civil court
open_evidence.custodian_es: Cada acreedor/obligado; custodio contable; órgano civil
open_evidence.closure_en: Map each invoice/work item, note and authority to its obligor, claim, judgment, enforcement, interest/costs, payment/realization credit and residual. Confirm both dockets; a matching sum is a locator, not proof of duplication.
open_evidence.closure_es: Vincular factura/trabajo, pagaré y poder con obligado, demanda, sentencia, ejecución, intereses/costas, pago/abono de realización y saldo. Confirmar ambos expedientes; coincidir en importe no prueba duplicidad.

open_evidence.title_es: Inmueble, derechos y límites de la masa
open_evidence.custodian_en: Registry; notary; court; owner; independent surveyor/valuer
open_evidence.custodian_es: Registro; notaría; juzgado; propietario; técnico/tasador independiente
open_evidence.closure_en: Certified history and physical/cadastral/registry crosswalk for each lot and right, possession, valuation and use. Keep fincas 8584/8588 and LPB/Matkator/third-party rights separate.
open_evidence.closure_es: Historial certificado y correspondencia física/catastral/registral por lote y derecho, posesión, valoración y uso. Separar fincas 8584/8588 y derechos LPB/Matkator/terceros.

open_evidence.custodian_en: Court; identified assignor/assignee; notary/Registry; payment custodian
open_evidence.custodian_es: Juzgado; cedente/cesionario identificado; notaría/Registro; custodio de pagos
open_evidence.closure_en: Actual negotiation/assignment instrument, order, price, funding, acceptance, registration/possession and debtor credit. Preserve the possibility that no transfer occurred.
open_evidence.closure_es: Instrumento real de negociación/cesión, resolución, precio, financiación, aceptación, inscripción/posesión y abono al deudor. Preservar la posibilidad de que no hubiera transmisión.

open_evidence.custodian_en: Engagement parties; professionals; independent accounting/valuation evidence
open_evidence.custodian_es: Partes del encargo; profesionales; prueba contable/tasadora independiente
open_evidence.closure_en: Actor, dated capacity, accepted task, available protective step, performance/breach, causation, claimant-specific loss and strongest lawful alternative. Avoid duplicate damages and automatic whole-hotel valuation.
open_evidence.closure_es: Actor, capacidad fechada, tarea aceptada, protección disponible, cumplimiento/incumplimiento, causalidad, daño de cada reclamante y mejor explicación lícita. Evitar daños duplicados o valor automático de todo el hotel.

open_evidence.title_en: Connection to wider control and funding
open_evidence.title_es: Conexión con control y financiación más amplios
open_evidence.custodian_en: Relevant court/administrator; transaction parties; financiers; programme authorities
open_evidence.custodian_es: Juzgado/AC pertinente; partes; financiadores; órganos del programa
open_evidence.closure_en: Exact transmitted instrument, accepted mandate, instruction/payment or decision-use link for each claimed connection. Preserve developed-rescue, historical-credit and known-response corrections; do not transfer intent through association.
open_evidence.closure_es: Instrumento transmitido exacto, mandato aceptado, instrucción/pago o uso decisorio por conexión. Conservar correcciones sobre rescate desarrollado, crédito histórico y respuesta conocida; no transmitir dolo por asociación.

continuity_closure.source_custody: Both handoffs and native evidence remain in the authorised private Library/source system. Re-query by package control; no private locator or original is copied into Git.
continuity_closure.correction_rule: Preserve private operational corrections, attempted-versus-effective communication, chronology/knowledge limits, client/obligor separation, prior work and historical-credit corrections. A held derivative is not deleted continuity or a public fact.

later_publication_lineage.meaning: Later unified release. It was preparation lineage before it subsequently merged; do not repeat the obsolete assertion it remains unmerged.
